en: Grunt
I said get lost! Nobody goes near that well. Team Rocket's orders!
Man
Ow! All right, all right, I'm going!
Grunt
What are you staring at? This well's closed for business. Move along!
Grunt
Slowpoke Well? Never heard of it. Now beat it before I lose my temper.
{rival}
...So it was you who chased Team Rocket out of the well. Don't think that makes you strong.
Team Rocket ganging up on a few Slowpoke. Pathetic. I'll show you what real strength is!
Tch. My Pokémon just aren't strong enough yet. I'll get stronger ones, whatever it takes.
Don't get in my way again.
The Slowpoke gave a long, slow yawn...
The Slowpoke used to doze in every street of this town. Now there's not one to be seen.
Our town has long said a Slowpoke's yawn brings the rain. It hasn't rained properly in days.
The Slowpoke are back! Look at them, yawning away as if nothing had happened.
Smell that? The charcoal kiln is going. Azalea's charcoal is the finest in Johto, so they say.
Though with Team Rocket hanging about the well, nobody's in the mood for buying.
You ran Team Rocket out of the well? Then the kiln will be busy again. Thanks!
